title: Dimensions for lengths of Hands for clocks
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12471) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Dimensions for lengths of Hands for clocks.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Connecting dimensions, fits and dimensions combinations of hands for clocks

clause_3_terminology: Dimensions for lengths of Hands for clocks

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
